adapter_policy: The history of the edits of each clip (user 2026-11-25): every Save of an edit writes an entry (when, a label, the state after it as its owner wrote it); any entry can be gone back to, which is itself a new entry. Kept per clip, the newest 200. A table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker): edit_history and the view public_edit_history. It owns only its table and is written only through the intermediary; it does not read the state.
